title: The U.S. Cut Cuba Off From the World’s Oil. Now It Runs on American Fuel.
summary: Growing American fuel shipments are keeping Cuba afloat after Trump’s oil embargo pushed the island to the brink of a humanitarian crisis.

title: Bessent Ties Attacks on French Fridges to Chinese AI Model
summary: A Chinese artificial intelligence model was used in recent hacks that disabled refrigerators in French supermarkets, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Thursday.

title: Americans ‘a bit naive’ about influence campaigns by Iran, Russia, China
summary: Americans have repeatedly underestimated foreign efforts to influence their politics and public opinion, leaving the US vulnerable to campaigns by China, Russia and Iran, says Sean Durns, director of the Counter Extremism Research Center at the Capital Research Center.

title: The Jensen Huang Scandal & How to Spot a Honey Trap | Straight up with Kelly and Vlad
summary: A billionaire, affairs, and an alleged honey trap at the hands of the Chinese government. This week, Vlad and Kelly are going inside the world of honey traps, Romeos, and sexpionage. With former intelligence officer and historian, Mark Jacobson, and investigative journalist and author of "The Game," Neil Strauss, they unpack how spies exploit attraction, ego, and emotions to get close to the world
